changes.change: Only a request with a sufficient retained raw-memory reservation can enter the read-visible graph. Private requests seal the queue immediately.
Hidden changed coordinates reach the existing atomic disk-root, revision, warm-source invalidation, and key-domain publication.
The batch retains the actual typed DeferReservation and verifies that its bytes cover the final staged memory quote.
Unreserved or undersized Memory/Background requests use immediate durable completion. Later write preparation waits for that commit.
Native mutation admission transfers its raw-byte reservation through the typed ownership API.
The captured graph drops before the batch owners that retain its memory reservation.

source_size_and_allow_check.scope_note: Includes untracked Rust source copies in proof receipts as well as product files.

queued_low_cap_observation.limit: The returned queued mode does not report the internal fallback. The one-byte configuration and source select the durable path. The ordinary run checks the returned values and visible graph state.

ordinary_product.scope: This bounded ordinary run checks product behavior. It does not measure memory peaks during the private durable request or prove a concurrent captured-read lifetime.

earlier_attempts.product: Configuration refusal: the 16 MiB key allowance refused the fixed preload work allowance. No mutation phase ran.
earlier_attempts.product-128m: Driver assertion error: background private work may advance the global accepted tail after a durable target completes. Equal global accepted/completed sequences are not the acknowledgement contract. One durable update and its value checks passed before this assertion.
earlier_attempts.product-final: Complete bounded ordinary API workload, with the corrected observation and 128 MiB key allowance.

limits: The ordinary run does not measure memory peaks during a private durable commit or directly prove a concurrent read lifetime.
The queued API response does not expose internal durable fallback. The one-byte configuration and source establish that fallback; returned values and visible graph state are observed separately.
Unreserved background requests seal the prefix immediately. They do not keep a collection delay without byte admission. No new performance comparison is claimed.
